svg.title: Magnetoelastic Boundary Conditions, Interface Continuity, and FDM vs FEM Spatial Meshing
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) multi-domain FM/NM mechanical boundary conditions including traction-free top surface, prescribed IDT traction, clamped base, Lysmer-Kuhlemeyer local impedance, Rayleigh ABL vs ADE CFS-PML absorbing collar, and FM/NM interface total-traction continuity, and (b) spatial meshing comparison between the staggered FDM Virieux/Lebedev velocity-stress stencil and conforming FEM SubMesh (Omega_m subset Omega_el, stripping Omega_air) with quadratic P2/locking-free elements.
